title: Find the leftmost insertion index in a sorted list
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: bisect_left returns the first index whose element is at least target, len(items) when there is none and 0 for an empty list, without modifying items.
The shortcut reads items[-1] before checking for an empty list, so lower_bound([], 7) raises IndexError instead of returning 0.
A half-open binary search returns the leftmost insertion point for every sorted list, including duplicates, targets past either end and the empty list.
The binary search is written in JavaScript as lowerBound, while the brief asks for a Python function lower_bound.
